input_schema.description:
A JSON Schema (an object) for the action's input: a frontend shows a form made
from it before running the action. The app checks the input it gets.

point.description: The extension point the action calls (`payments.capture`); this or `url`.

url.description: The app's own URL the action calls; this or `point`.

target.description: The slot it fills (`order.payment`): admins show the targets they implement.

id.description: Lowercase letters, digits, `-` and `_`; unique among the app's pages.

blocks.description: Blocks on admin pages (`order.payment`, …), answered as UI trees.

pages.description: Full pages under the app (`apps.page`), in an iframe.

proxy.description:
The app's endpoint behind `/admin/apps/{app}/proxy/…`: what an admin's settings
form saves to, and anything else an admin calls the app for.

version.description: The contract's version the app implements, from 1.

schema.description: A JSON Schema (an object) for the app's settings form.

secret_fields.description: Fields of the form that hold secrets: shown masked.

elements.description: Web components a storefront may load.

events.description: Event types (`order.placed`), every type of a kind (`product.*`) or `*`. 1 to 50.

url.description: Where Hypha POSTs events, signed with the app's secret.

module.description: The ES module that defines the element.

tag.description: The custom element's tag: lowercase, with a `-` (`stripe-payment`).

description:
An app manifest as written (`hypha-app.json`). URLs other than `app_url` may be
relative: they resolve against `app_url`. Fields not listed here are refused, so a
typo is caught rather than ignored.

admin.description: What the app adds to an admin.

app_url.description:
The app's base URL (`https://`, or `http://localhost` in development): every
relative URL below resolves against it.

extension_points.description: The extension points the app implements (`payments.start` v1, …).

icon.description: A square image, shown beside its name.

key.description:
The app's key: `app_` and lowercase letters, digits and underscores, at most 64
characters. The same in every store that installs it.

name.description: Its name, as staff see it on the consent screen and in the admin.

privacy_url.description: The app's privacy policy, linked from the consent screen.

publisher.description: Who makes it, shown on the consent screen.

redirect_uris.description:
Where Hypha may send the browser back after consent: `/oauth/authorize`'s
`redirect_uri` must be one of these exactly. 1 to 10; none for a private app,
whose manifest is uploaded and which gets its tokens on approval.

scope_reasons.description:
Why the app needs a scope, shown on the consent screen. Required for every
`customer_data:*` scope it asks for.

scopes.description: The scopes the app asks for (`orders:read`, `customer_data:email`, …).

settings.description: A settings form any admin can render without the app's own page.

storefront.description: What the app adds to a storefront.

version.description: The app's own version (`1.2.0`), shown to staff.

webhooks.description: Where the app's webhooks go and which events it wants.

title: Hypha app manifest
